policy: Section 232 polysilicon MIP program: raw polysilicon floor
legal_authority: Section 232 (19 USC 1862); Section 604 Trade Act of 1974 (19 USC 2483); Proclamation 11052 cl. (1)-(3); HTSUS ch. 99 subch. III U.S. note 42, heading 9903.45.33 (as numbered in annex)
trusted_treatment: No country exemption from MIP. The 5(b)/(c) caps cover only the cl. (4) ad valorem duty. Note 42(b): FTA/GN 3(c)(i) preference goods (incl. USMCA) still pay. Cl. (10) lets the Secretary change MIP applicability for a partner with a substantially equivalent MIP; none announced.
nonaligned_treatment: Same as all countries (no country-specific rate)
coercive_treatment: Same as all countries: no China-specific rate and no foreign-entity-of-concern rule
tariff_rate: Specific duty = $21/kg if importer submits no documentation; = $21/kg minus entered value if documented but entered value below MIP; none if entered value >= MIP and resale condition met. No 15% ad valorem duty on 2804.61 (cl. 4 covers ingots and derivatives only).
stacking: Cl. 5(a): in addition to all other duties unless otherwise specified. Note 42(b): AD/CVD and other duties continue. 2804.61.00 is on the 2026 forced-labor Section 301 exemption list (note 52(b)/9903.05.86, 91 FR 47318), so that 301 duty does not apply. China 301 duties are not addressed by the proclamation and continue.
investment_onshoring_treatment: Cl. (6): approved onshoring plans may import Covered Products (raw polysilicon, ingots, wafers, cells) and production equipment free of applicable 232 duties during construction; program not yet implemented.
review_mechanism: Secretary may adjust MIPs from time to time (cl. 1(b)); ongoing import monitoring and reports to the President (cl. 11); annex technical corrections by FR notice (cl. 9); anti-circumvention rules incl. related-party manipulation (cl. 13); no sunset (cl. 5(a)).
how_used_in_explainer: Flag only: no ad valorem equivalent (no $/W or $/kg price data at HS10 x partner level)
notes: How the MIP is measured. At entry the importer certifies one of two things: the first arm's-length US sale of the goods (or of downstream products made from them) will be at or above the MIP, or that sale is under fixed terms of a contract signed before 2026-08-06. CBP compares the entered value on the entry summary with the MIP. Note 42(a) says 9903.45.33-36 do not apply if entered value >= MIP and (1) the goods are not resold and downstream products sell at or above the MIP, (2) they are resold at or above the MIP, or (3) they are resold under a time-limited fixed-term contract signed before 2026-08-06. Investigation opened 2025-07-01 (90 FR 31955). Heading 9903.45.33 shares its number range with the quartz safeguard headings; see unresolved.
